newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour to give export drive highest priority.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour to give export drive highest priority.

text.p: A British Labour government would give the promotion of exports "the highest possible priority", appointing leading business people to Foreign Office posts, foreign affairs spokesman Derek Fatchett said on Tuesday.
Speaking to a conference organised by the party's Industry Forum, he said: "We will set out to establish a new partnership between business and the Foreign Office."
Asked about Labour's plans by Reuters, Fatchett recalled the party had already said it would consider appointing a few top businessmen to senior diplomatic posts, even up to the rank of ambassador.
In addition it wanted to encourage short-term secondments of Foreign Office staff to industry and vice-versa.

Fatchett told the conference: "We will give strong encouragement to small businesses so that they can take the leap into exporting. That means getting information where it is needed fast." -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
